The hand rotates the bottle to show the "GAUDIAMUS" branding against a light marble background. (3) The bottle sits on a marble-style kitchen countertop with cooking utensils, a knife block, and a small yellow toy car blurred in the background. (4) The woman reappears, using expressive hand gestures to emphasize her speech while looking directly at the camera. (5) A hand pours clear olive oil from the bottle into a black Staub cast-iron pot on an induction hob, followed by three raw chicken drumsticks being placed inside. (6) Olive oil is poured into a small white ceramic dipping dish on a kitchen counter. (7) Close-up shots of green and reddish olives hanging on a branch under a bright blue sky, with a hand gently touching the fruit. (11) A pan on a stove is used to stir-fry colorful sliced vegetables like broccoli and peppers. (12) A hand holds a white box containing small vinegar bottles labeled "Bonini Black," followed by a close-up of a specific "Bonini 12 Affinato" bottle. (15) A dark syrup is poured onto a large vanilla milkshake or sundae topped with whipped cream. (16) The woman laughs and reacts, while two cartoon characters (an owl and a black penguin) appear at the bottom of the frame.
